content: Firebase RTDB ref.off(eventType, callback) removes a listener only if callback is the exact same function reference passed to on(). Passing a fresh anonymous/arrow function (even with identical code) to off() will not match and silently fails to detach. Calling on() multiple times with the same callback registers it multiple times, requiring off() to be called an equal number of times, or omit the callback arg to off() to remove all listeners for that eventType/ref.
